name: react-app
title: React app (single Vite app)
description: One Vite/React 19 app carrying the whole frontend: an RTK Query data layer with a single baseApi, better-auth session handling and route guards, the login/signup/reset screens as routes, a shadcn-style UI kit with light/dark theming, layouts and state screens, and generated OpenAPI types. Same stack as react-monorepo, one deployment.

ui.title: UI kit (src/shared/ui)
ui.description: shadcn-style Radix components, a Formik+Zod form helper, light/dark theming with a no-flash init script, and page-meta helpers.

api.title: Data layer (src/shared/api)
api.description: One RTK Query baseApi that every feature extends via injectEndpoints, a configured store, and an upload-aware base query. Endpoint names and tagTypes live in one global namespace — collisions are silent, so keep them unique.

auth.title: Auth (src/shared/auth)
auth.description: better-auth browser client, session slice, and route guards. Single origin, so the guard navigates to /login rather than redirecting to another host.

layouts.title: Layouts (src/shared/layouts)
layouts.description: App shell, auth layout, marketing layout, error boundary and the loading/empty/forbidden/not-found state screens.

auth-screens.title: Auth screens
auth-screens.description: Login, signup, forgot/reset password, email verification as routes. Drop this only if you are bringing your own /login — the guards and the 401 handler both send unauthenticated users there.

types.title: Generated API types (src/shared/types)
types.description: OpenAPI-generated request/response types and Zod schemas, regenerated from the backend's /openapi-json by `yarn gen`.

marketing.title: Marketing site
marketing.description: A public landing page at `/`, an SEO route table, and build-time robots.txt / sitemap.xml / security.txt. Including it moves the authenticated app to /app so the landing page can own the root — see src/lib/paths.ts.

admin.title: Admin console
admin.description: A role-gated /admin branch with its own nav, over the same data layer. The guard decides what renders; the API still has to enforce the role.

realtime.title: Socket.IO client
realtime.description: socket.io-client wired to the backend's /realtime path, with room helpers and shared event-name constants. Pairs with the nest-api realtime feature.

pwa.title: Installable PWA
pwa.description: vite-plugin-pwa: app-shell offline caching and an update prompt rather than a silent takeover.

charts.title: Charts
charts.description: ApexCharts via react-apexcharts, theme-aware through the shared chart palette.

docker.title: Docker image
docker.description: Multi-stage build producing a static bundle, served by the nginx config in docker/ (cache rules, SPA fallback, security headers).

hooks.title: format (the feature strip leaves valid but unformatted code)
git init
hooks.run: git init -q && git add -A && git commit -qm 'chore: scaffold {{name}} from the react-app template'

nextSteps: Edit .env — VITE_APP_API_URL must point at your backend.
Routes live in src/routes; shared code in src/shared; see src/lib/paths.ts for where the app is mounted.
